about_the_game:
HOTDOG: THE VIDEOGAME - SURFING USA EDITION

You’re out of a job, but not out of dreams. With your savings, you grab a hot dog cart and hit the beaches of the USA. Sell fast food, grow your business, and aim for the stars! Serve hot dogs with an insane, mind-blowing variety of toppings that drive customers wild, plus burgers, fries, coffee, ice cream, and sodas. Your aim is efficient greatness. Race against time, satisfy demanding customers who want their food now, and transform your cart into the ultimate fast-food joint. Ready to shine under the sun?

THE DREAMED ROADMAP

  • Develop your character's dream: the greatest fast-food restaurant ever.

  • 3 to 4 player co-op gameplay.

  • More ingredients.

  • Coffee station.

  • Dynamic weather, day/night cycle. Storms, rain, etc.

  • Self-sustaining food business: grow crops, raise animals, produce raw materials (make your sausages, burgers, with your own recipes!). Alone or with friends.

    It all starts with a hotdog. Join this adventure!

short_description: Solo or with a friend, manage multiple hot dog stands in a dynamic and realistic business simulator. Sell fast food, customize it with unique toppings, upgrade your equipment and your stand to a food truck, and serve demanding customers against the clock to achieve efficient greatness.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Spanish - Latin America
